binding.profile_built_from: the committed default profile plus amendment_2 built only from the record's ten values

faculty_decisions.FD-AUTH-01: Ratify GI_DEVELOPMENT_SNAPSHOT_V1 for DEVELOPMENT EXPERIMENTS. Status RATIFIED_FOR_DEVELOPMENT_EXPERIMENTS. Not a clinical calibration, a production profile, a resident profile or an authority-approved snapshot. Preserve LOW, V1 and HIGH as sensitivity witnesses; do not replace the underlying development region with V1.
FD-AUTH-02: it satisfies the predeclared H1-H7 criteria
it is interior to every approved parameter region
it maximizes the minimum boundary margin
no legacy output was used in the selection rule
CENTER_REFERENCE was not automatically selected and in fact violates one region-bound criterion
causal ordering is stable across both GI cases
faculty_decisions.FD-AUTH-03: No authority yet: COMMON_CORE_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY stays False and no common-core output writes into the real encounter.

falsifiers: an ordering or safety invariant violated at the snapshot on any recorded or new GI course (onset order, monotone untreated course, no collapse-led UNRESPONSIVE, no fall of F before the order, no two-band give-back)

the FD-P3-176 recovery invariant failing on a physical recovery of the snapshot (0.80 to below 0.50 outside 6 to 8 min, more than 2 minutes left after the formal entry, or less than 79 % of the descent done before it)
the independent evaluator and the live Amendment-2 channels disagreeing for the snapshot (the exactness test)
a faculty change to a region bound that leaves the snapshot on, near (< 5 %) or outside a bound
a new GI case, a new supported treatment or a new core lineage member that changes the physical course enough to change which magnitudes are HIGH_SENSITIVITY
the common-core digest moving (a new amendment): the snapshot is then re-derived as a NEW version
reopening_rule: Snapshot selection is not reopened unless a cycle finds a new structural contradiction (FD-AUTH-02).

hard: lies strictly inside every approved region (no magnitude on a region bound)
keeps every faculty behavioural invariant (FD-P3-176 recovery invariant, ordering of the onset and collapse events)
keeps the causal order, the recovery behaviour and the collapse semantics on every scenario
generalises across both GI cases (event times differ by at most one minute)
is deterministic (re-evaluation equals the record exactly)
has explicit provenance (a complete, digest-pinned record)
is not selected to mimic a legacy timing (the rule reads no legacy value)
ranked: the largest minimum normalised margin to the region bounds
the fewest magnitudes outside the LOW..HIGH witness bracket
the most interpretable provenance (a parameter-free rule over the faculty regions, not an arbitrary draw)

selection_rule: Among the candidates strictly inside every region, the one with the largest minimum normalised margin to the region bounds (R1); ties by fewest magnitudes outside the LOW..HIGH bracket (R2). For a box region the maximiser is UNIQUE: each magnitude at the middle of its own faculty-approved region.

sensitivity_witnesses.note: LOW and HIGH are the core's own witnesses, unchanged. CENTER_REFERENCE stays a test witness of the layer and is not the snapshot. The sweep of the full region stays the sensitivity check.
